design.name: Special 170 — Đàn guitar (mốc 190)
design.author: Codex
design.notes:
Nguồn R7 vị trí190 →170. GD: không giảm số vòng; source cao hơn curve giữ nguyên, source thấp hơn bổ sung vòng có link thật. Chuẩn hóa độ dày bằng official builder. Chuẩn hóa độ dày và điều chỉnh bám curve hơn. Ghi chú nguồn chỉ là tham khảo: User explicitly changed the instrument to guitar. Portrait acoustic-guitar silhouette: eight waist/body-rim sections, two sound-hole rings, two neck sections, four headstock sections, six L tuning keys and two bridge strokes. 24 anatomical instrument parts. Body rim bars are pin-coupled to sound hole; full role and visual checks pending. Gameplay revision: tuning keys extend inward to straddle headstock joints; middle keys slide vertically, two headstock pieces block their paths. Neck/headstock stay within the approved portrait proportions (height increase under 3%). Needs a fresh visual comparison after proof.
Runtime repair: widened existing open arcs to160 degrees while retaining icon, ring count, fixed width and physically mounted pins; must re-validate, solve, replay and ablate.
